instruction.text: Follow the path with the white arrow.
instruction.sound: Which pet belongs to which child? Follow the path with the white arrow. Start with Noah.

atoms.finishSound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>bark-dog</voice> Correct, Noah has a dog.

instruction.text: Follow the path with the white arrow.
instruction.sound: And which pet belongs to Cara? Follow the path with the white arrow.

atoms.finishSound: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>bubbles</voice> Cara has a fish called Oscar.

instruction.text: Follow the path with the white arrow.
instruction.sound: And what kind of pet does Mike have? Follow the path with the white arrow.

atoms.finishSound: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>bird-singing</voice> Exactly, Mike’s pet is a bird.

instruction.text: Follow the path with the white arrow.
instruction.sound: What do these three children like to do. Follow the path with the white arrow. Start with Tamara.

instruction.text: Follow the path with the white arrow.
instruction.sound: And which hobby does Luke have? Follow the path with the white arrow.

instruction.text: Follow the path with the white arrow.
instruction.sound: And once more: what does Mya find fun? Follow the path with the white arrow.

atoms.finishSound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>instrument-violin-1</voice><break time='500ms'/> Mya enjoys playing the violin often.

instruction.text: Follow the path with the white arrow.
instruction.sound: Which clothes match which weather? Follow the path with the white arrow.

atoms.finishSound: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>waves-on-beach2</voice> Correct! the swimming things belong to sunny weather.

instruction.text: Follow the path with the white arrow.
instruction.sound: And which weather do the rubber boots and raincoat belong to? Follow the path with the white arrow.

atoms.finishSound: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>raindrops</voice> Exactly! you wear these clothes when it rains.

instruction.text: Follow the path with the white arrow.
instruction.sound: Once more: in what kind of weather do you wear a warm Jacket, gloves and a hat? Follow the path with the white arrow.

atoms.finishSound: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>footsteps-snow</voice> Fantastic, you were these clothes in the Winter when it snows.
